nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $u, v$ be units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$. Then there are $x_0, y_0 \in \mathbb{Z}_p$ and a unit $z_0$ of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ with $z_0^2 = u x_0^2 + v y_0^2$.
nodes.title: For odd $p$, a binary unit form over $\mathbb{Z}_p$ represents a unit square

nodes.summary: Unit diagonal forms in at least three variables over $\mathbb{Q}_p$ are isotropic for odd $p$. Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $n > 2$, and let $a_1, \dots, a_n$ be units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$. Then there is a nonzero vector $(x_1, \dots, x_n) \in \mathbb{Q}_p^n$ with $a_1 x_1^2 + \dots + a_n x_n^2 = 0$.
nodes.title: Unit diagonal forms in at least three variables over $\mathbb{Q}_p$ are isotropic for odd $p$

nodes.summary: For nonzero real numbers $a$ and $b$, the real Hilbert symbol of $a$ and $b$ equals $-1$ if and only if there are no real numbers $x, y$ with $a x^2 + b y^2 = 1$.
nodes.title: Real Hilbert symbol equal to $-1$

nodes.summary: For nonzero real numbers $a$ and $b$, the real Hilbert symbol of $a$ and $b$ equals $-1$ if and only if $a < 0$ and $b < 0$.
nodes.title: Sign rule for the real Hilbert symbol

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and nonzero $a, b \in \mathbb{Q}_p$, the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_p$ equals $-1$ if and only if there are no $x, y \in \mathbb{Q}_p$ with $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$.
nodes.title: When the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol is $-1$

nodes.summary: For nonzero real numbers $a$ and $b$, the real Hilbert symbol of $a$ and $b$ equals $1$ if and only if there are real numbers $x, y$ with $a x^2 + b y^2 = 1$.
nodes.title: Real Hilbert symbol equal to $1$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and nonzero $a, b \in \mathbb{Q}_p$, the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_p$ equals $1$ if and only if there exist $x, y \in \mathbb{Q}_p$ with $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$.
nodes.title: When the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol is $1$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and all nonzero $a, b \in \mathbb{Q}_p$, the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_p$ equals $1$ or $-1$.
nodes.title: The $p$-adic Hilbert symbol is $\pm 1$

nodes.summary: For nonzero real numbers $a$ and $b$, the real Hilbert symbol of $a$ and $b$ equals $1$ or $-1$.
nodes.title: The real Hilbert symbol is $\pm 1$

nodes.summary: For every field $F$ and all nonzero $a, b \in F$, the Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_F$ of $a$ and $b$ over $F$ equals $1$ or $-1$.
nodes.title: The Hilbert symbol of a field is $\pm 1$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $u, v$ be units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$. Then the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol of $u$ and $v$, viewed as units of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, equals $1$.
nodes.title: The Hilbert symbol of two $p$-adic units is trivial for odd $p$

nodes.summary: For a field $F$ and nonzero elements $a, b \in F$, the Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_F$ is the integer $1$ if there exist $x, y \in F$ with $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$, and $-1$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Hilbert symbol of a field

nodes.summary: For a field $F$ and nonzero elements $a, b \in F$, the equation $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$ is solvable over $F$ if there exist $x, y \in F$ with $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$.
nodes.title: Solvability of $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and nonzero $a, b \in \mathbb{Q}_p$, the $p$-adic Hilbert symbol $(a, b)_p$ is the integer $1$ if there exist $x, y \in \mathbb{Q}_p$ with $ax^2 + by^2 = 1$, and $-1$ otherwise.
nodes.title: The $p$-adic Hilbert symbol

nodes.summary: For nonzero real numbers $a$ and $b$, the real Hilbert symbol of $a$ and $b$ is the integer $1$ if there are real numbers $x, y$ with $a x^2 + b y^2 = 1$, and the integer $-1$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Real Hilbert symbol

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and a unit $u$ of $\mathbb{Z}_p$, the image of $u$ under the inclusion of the units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ into the units of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, viewed as an element of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, equals $u$ viewed as an element of $\mathbb{Q}_p$.
nodes.title: Value of the inclusion of $p$-adic integer units

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, this is the map from the units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ to the units of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ induced by the inclusion $\mathbb{Z}_p \subseteq \mathbb{Q}_p$.
nodes.title: Inclusion of $p$-adic integer units

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
